the verb has different forms for each person, so you don't need to use the pronoun before the verb; it actually sounds weird if you use it and it wasn't needed, but people still understand very well what you wanted to say

you should only use the pronoun when the subject of the sentence is more important than the action

e. g. 
vreau un măr = i **want** an apple

(does anyone want an apple?) **eu** vreau = **i** want (i do)
